profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: University of Texas at San Antonio alumnus seeking opportunities in software engineering, systems engineering, DevOps, and the game development industry. Graduated with B.S. Computer Science December 2021.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing distributed systems and automation using C#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure, and Java

positions.title: Software Developer/IT Specialist
positions.description:
•	Designed and constructed a company website using the React JavaScript library, offering a platform to display services and encourage customer inquiries. Leveraged the Google Cloud Firebase platform to deploy the website, employing serverless backend architecture with Google Cloud Functions to eliminate hosting expenses.
•	Enhanced office workstation and building surveillance systems by upgrading both hardware and software infrastructure.
•	Created digital file system to store and organize customer information using Microsoft OneDrive
•	Enhanced the client and estimator experience through the implementation of Adobe E-Sign for securing client permissions documents.
•	Led the company rebranding initiative by utilizing Adobe Illustrator to modernize the company logo, revamping employee attire, and establishing a digital platform for enhanced business presence.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), HTML and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with a team of developers and data analysts to automate the collection and distribution of client financial data to multiple financial journalism databases. 
•	Created custom processes to collect financial investment data via Excel spreadsheets, increasing overall data throughput by 25%, allowing automation of analyst daily tasks and client growth.
•	Modernized various dashboard pages on analyst hub to display data analytics using C#, SQL, Blazor, HTML, and CSS, complete with customization per clients’ requests.
•	Created a reconciliation export with screenshots of distributed data for clients to review and confirm accuracy.
•	Assisted in training new developers to help familiarize them with the existing codebase and use best practices.
•	Utilized Microsoft Azure to manage code source control and complete work items during Agile sprints.
